title: Coordinate pollen forecast
scenario: Read the selected place's pollen from server1. The example was captured from a local server1 gateway using an isolated synthetic Tokyo response.

steps.title: Read the date and available species
steps.instruction: If the ordinary coordinate weather advertises pollenForecastAvailable, request the same coordinate path with /pollen-forecast. Read the region and the dateUtc reported by Google for the viewed location, along with source, credit and plant or pollen type codes.
steps.caption: An isolated Tokyo gateway response with a UTC date and Japanese cedar. The numeric index is absent.
steps.expected: Use the UTC date as given. Keep the index missing when it is absent and keep an explicit zero when provided. Preserve ordinary weather when the optional forecast is unavailable.
